name: There is NO PLAN B
source:
Step into the shoes of Detective B, a private detective for Soul City, completely controlled by the mega-corporation Trinity Inc., in order to solve a wide array of incidents occurring.

Ah, and you know Hikikomori, yes? Well, the main character, B, is one of those, absolutely refusing to leave her home.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演B侦探，灵魂之城的私家侦探，完全由巨型企业Trinity Inc. 控制，以解决发生的各种事件。

啊，你知道蛰居族，是吗？主角B就是其中之一，她绝对不肯离开家。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928190/]Steam[/url]]
